adopt: Collect votes, answers and comments into one file and ask it a question with the answers cited.
description:
Kind: tool

Problem
Feedback lives in five places at once: a suggestion board, a chat poll, a survey form, a forum thread, a rating with a reason. Each keeps its own counter and its own idea of who voted, so the honest question -- what do the people in this group actually want, and who said so -- needs five exports and a spreadsheet, and a weighted vote on one surface is a raw count on the next.

Install
pip install awcrowd

Commands
  awcrowd

Quick start
  pip install -e.
  awcrowd --self-test
  awcrowd sources --source discord:/path/to/guilds.db
  awcrowd query "should we rename the product?" --source discord:guilds.db --scope guild=<id> --since 30d
  awcrowd export --anonymized --out./crowd-corpus --source discord:guilds.db
  awcrowd consent withdraw --world <guild> --person <member>
  awcrowd decide --yes 7 --no 2 --eligible 10 # 70% turnout + 65% yes

Docs
https://aitherium.github.io/awcrowd/
synopsis: Ask your crowd, keep every answer, and ask the answers a question.
